title: Clear terms, kept simply
lede: What you can expect from Sarvakali, what Sarvakali asks of you, and what happens if plans change.
draftNote: Draft for Sarvakali to decide, and for a lawyer to review before launch. Not legal advice.
care: If you are in crisis, please reach out to someone now: in India, Tele-MANAS is free and answers at any hour on 14416. Nothing on this page replaces a doctor, a therapist or emergency help.

sections.title: Who we are, and these terms
paras: This website and the sessions booked through it are offered by Sarvakali ([legal name, as on the GST registration or PAN], [address]). By booking a session, paying an invoice or making an account, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not book.

These terms sit alongside the [Boundaries and care](/care) page, which explains what this work is and is not, and how your details are kept. Nothing here takes away the rights you have under India’s consumer protection law.

sections.title: What this work is, and is not
paras: Readings, rituals, energy work, devotional practice and spiritual guidance are offered as spiritual, reflective and educational support. They are not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice, and they are never a reason to stop or delay treatment you are receiving.
points: No outcome is promised. Sarvakali will not promise to cure an illness, win back a person, guarantee wealth or change another person’s will, and you should be wary of anyone who does.
Nothing on this site is offered as a remedy for any disease or disorder. Where something touches the body or the mind, please keep working with your doctor or therapist.

Sarvakali does not take on work meant to harm, control or bind another person against their will, or anything unlawful, including practices prohibited under India’s anti-superstition and black magic laws.

Sarvakali may decline or end any piece of work, before or during it, if it is not right for you or for the practice. You will be told why, as far as is kind and possible, and refunded as set out below.

sections.title: Age
paras: Sessions and accounts are for people aged 18 and over. Someone younger may only take part with a parent or guardian who books, agrees and stays involved.

sections.title: Booking a session
paras: You ask for a conversation through [Connect](/connect), suggesting times that suit you, in any time zone. Sarvakali confirms one of them or offers others. A session is booked once a time is confirmed: you receive an email with the time in your own zone and the Google Meet link, and your own booking page, where you can move or cancel it.
Please join from somewhere private, on a connection that can hold a video call. Sessions are not recorded by either side unless both agree beforehand.

sections.title: Paying
paras: Payment is by UPI only, after a time is confirmed, against an invoice that shows the UPI ID and a QR code, and the date it is due. Fees are agreed with you before any work begins; nothing is charged that you have not agreed to. Where tax applies, it is shown on the invoice.
Sarvakali will never ask for card numbers, bank passwords, a UPI PIN or a one-time code. If anyone does in Sarvakali’s name, please do not pay, and tell us.

sections.title: Moving or cancelling
paras: Life happens. You can move or cancel a session from your booking page or by replying to your confirmation email.
points: More than 24 hours before the start: move or cancel freely. If you have paid, you choose a new time or a full refund.

Within 24 hours of the start: you may move it once, without charge. A cancellation this late is not refunded, unless it is because of illness, an emergency or a loss, which Sarvakali will always treat kindly.
If you do not join within 15 minutes of the start and have not written, the session counts as held.
If Sarvakali has to move or cancel, or the call fails on Sarvakali’s side, you choose a new time or a full refund.

sections.title: Refunds
paras: Refunds are sent to the same UPI ID you paid from, within 7 working days of being agreed, and you are told when they are sent.
points: A session that has been held is not refunded. If something went wrong, please tell Sarvakali: it will be heard, and put right where it can be.

Ritual work done on your behalf (for example a puja or a spell performed for you) is refunded in full if cancelled before it begins. Once it has begun it cannot be undone or refunded; anything bought for it is used for it.
A course or a series is refunded for the sessions not yet held.
Where Sarvakali declines or ends a piece of work, what has not been delivered is refunded in full.

sections.title: Respect, both ways
paras: Sarvakali will listen without judgement and keep what you share confidential, except where the law requires otherwise or someone is in danger. In return, please be respectful. Sarvakali may end a session that becomes abusive or unsafe; what remains of it is not refunded in that case.

sections.title: Using this website
paras: The practices, articles, drawings and design on this site are Sarvakali’s, and are offered for your own personal practice. Please do not copy them for sale or republish them without permission. Traditional mantras, prayers and verses belong to their traditions; the library gives their sources.

Accounts are optional. If you make one, keep access to your email, which is how you sign in, and remember your journal passphrase: nobody can recover it. You can download or delete your account at any time in [My space](/me).

sections.title: Responsibility
paras: Sarvakali takes care to be accurate and kind, but spiritual work depends on many things outside anyone’s control. As far as the law allows, Sarvakali’s responsibility for any session or piece of work is limited to the amount you paid for it. Nothing in these terms limits any right you have under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, or any responsibility that cannot be limited by law.

sections.title: Complaints
paras: If something is not right, please tell us first, through your booking page or your confirmation email: most things can be put right quickly. Complaints are acknowledged within 48 hours and answered within a month; questions about your personal data are answered well within the 90 days the law allows.

Grievance officer: [name], [email address]. If you are not satisfied, you can approach the National Consumer Helpline (1915, or consumerhelpline.gov.in), and for your personal data, the Data Protection Board of India.

sections.title: If these terms change
paras: These terms may be updated; the date at the top shows when. A session already booked keeps the terms it was booked under. These terms are governed by the laws of India, and the courts of [city] have jurisdiction.
